title: The Life-Power
author: Paul Case
imprint: From a typed copy of the four parts
edition: The four parts as typed, from a later copy; the first typing is not held
publicDomain: Written in 1922–23 and issued to Case's students as lesson sheets. If that issue was publication, the text has been in the public domain in the US since 1 January 2019; if it was not, a work of Case's (he died in 1954) that was never published came into the public domain there on 1 January 2025. (A first publication between 1978 and 2002 would run to the end of 2047. None is known: to be confirmed.)
note: Set from a scan of a later retyped copy of the four parts, which carries the address of the Stichting Argus archive and was made in 2009; who typed the copy, and when, it does not say, and the first typing is not held. Each page was read three times, by Mistral OCR, by Tesseract and by the scan's own text layer, and the three were compared word for word. The words the copy underlines are in italics: they were measured on the page images and every page was then checked by eye. Twelve typing slips of the copy are corrected (letters transposed, doubled or dropped); what is doubtful is left as typed.
